newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO sees capacity growth of 36.5 pct by 2006/07.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO sees capacity growth of 36.5 pct by 2006/07.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Friday it plans to boost its power-providing capacity by 36.5 percent over the next 10 years.

TEPCO, Japan's largest power utility, said in its newly revised 10-year outlook released on Friday that it expects it power-providing capacity to total 89.04 million kilowatts (kw) by the end of the 2006/07 fiscal year from 65.23 million kw now.
TEPCO produces most of its power but also purchases some power from other producers.
The plans are based on TEPCO's forecast that its electricity sales will grow by an annual average of two percent over the 10-year period.
